elements.note: Main building panel: 40 A 2-pole main with a 30 mA ELCB, four 16 A final circuits each serving both lighting and socket outlets.
Toilet-block panel: a single 16 A 2-pole breaker in a box ('CIRCUIT BREAKER พร้อมกล่อง'), fed by 2-4 mm² THW. No sub-circuits are drawn -- the whole block is one circuit.

warnings: TWO separate single-line diagrams, one per building -- further confirmation that this drawing set covers two independent structures (spec §11a). building is null at the wrapper because both are on this one view.
The main building's board is far larger than the toilet block's: 40 AT main + 30 mA ELCB + four 16 AT ways, versus a single 16 AT breaker for the whole toilet block.
Circuits 1-4 are each labelled 'แสงสว่าง+เต้ารับไฟฟ้า', i.e. lighting and sockets share every final circuit rather than being separated.
Incoming supply is overhead ('เดินลอยในอากาศ'), 1-10 mm² THW.
